verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports connecting MCP servers to add custom tools/capabilities (gh-5, gh-19), which is the generic mechanism that could extend context to third-party services, but the evidence never mentions Jira, Slack, or Google Drive specifically or any pre-built connectors for them. Missing for 10: named/official Jira, Slack, or Google Drive integrations or MCP servers, and any documented example of using these workflow tools with Gemini CLI.
